content.short: MarketRaker, trading indicators without the noise of the market.
content.description:
MarketRaker is a platform that applies its model to historical market data to generate indicators for identifying profitable trading opportunities and managing risk.

The simulation results will be published once they are verified by a trusted third party. Users are encouraged to consider their own risk tolerance and market conditions when making trading decisions. The project leverages AI techniques, including machine learning and deep learning algorithms, to uncover hidden correlations and insights in large volumes of data.
